verdict.rationale: Rive lets you export files to the .riv runtime format, which open-source runtimes can load, and RML offers an XML text representation of Rive files that could make content portable. However, nothing documents a full account or data export. Community comments say there is no movie or video export, and that the open-source pieces still depend on the proprietary Editor to author content, which weakens a clean exit. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all projects and assets, confirmation that existing editor files can be exported to RML or other open formats, standard interchange formats (video, SVG, etc.), and independent evidence that users can leave without lock-in.
